convert_maskformer_checkpoint: convert a MaskFormer Detectron2 checkpoint to HuggingFace MaskFormerModel and MaskFormerForInstanceSegmentation models
build_maskformer_config: build a MaskFormerConfig from an original Detectron2 MaskFormer config object
build_image_processor: build a MaskFormerImageProcessor from an original Detectron2 config object
test_model_conversion: test the converted MaskFormer model against the original Detectron2 model on a sample image
get_model_name: get a HuggingFace model name string from a checkpoint file path
